Zevin Asset Management Position in Unilever Plc (UL) Has Lowered as Share Price Declined; Halsey Associates Has Lowered Its Monsanto (MON) Position by $387,672 as Stock Rose
May 23, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Halsey Associates Inc decreased its stake in Monsanto (MON) by 4.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Halsey Associates Inc sold 3,342 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.12% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 77,827 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.09 million, down from 81,169 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Halsey Associates Inc who had been investing in Monsanto for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $55.49 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.01% or $0.015 during the last trading session, reaching $125.745. About 585,970 shares traded. Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) has risen 3.06% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.49% the S&P500.
